basic_info.chief_complaint: Pain in lower right back tooth for several days

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: Pain in lower right back tooth for several days

present_illness.present_illness: The left/right lower back teeth have been repeatedly swollen and painful for several months/year, and were relieved by self-administered antibiotics. The pain has worsened in the past three days, with throbbing pain, swelling of the cheek, and fever.

past_history.present_illness: The left/right lower back teeth have been repeatedly swollen and painful for several months/year, and were relieved by self-administered antibiotics. The pain has worsened in the past three days, with throbbing pain, swelling of the cheek, and fever.

oral_examination.oral_examination: The left/right cheek is red and swollen near the angle of the mandible, and the skin temperature increases. In the mouth, the mesial area is impacted, the surrounding gums are red and swollen, the blind pocket is deep, and pus overflows.

treatment_plan.definitive: 1. Apply local irrigation and medicine; 2. Give antibiotic drip/oral antibiotics throughout the body; 3. Remove as soon as possible after the inflammation is eliminated.

source_handle: The area was flushed alternately with hydrogen peroxide and normal saline, and an antibiotic film/iodine mixture was placed in the blind bag.
